summary: Bug fix VERIFIED: 'not uploading images' on web is fixed. Backend pytest 9/9 passed (OTP login -> create album -> 3 multipart uploads -> persistence GET -> preview/thumbnail/original URLs all HTTP 200 image/jpeg bytes -> auto-generate produces non-empty pages containing all 3 photos -> final GET consistent). Web E2E passed end-to-end: login (9876501234, OTP from inline dev_hint since WHATSAPP_PROVIDER=aoc with unapproved template) -> home-create-hero -> first cover -> /create/upload?albumId=... -> Playwright file chooser uploaded 3 JPGs via expo-image-picker -> NO error banner -> '3 photos' counter -> 3 thumbnails (upload-photo-*) -> 'Design my album (3 photos)' enabled -> auto-generate -> landed on /album/{id}/preview with working 3D preview. The UI-created album (3e7f30eb3a2f48a7b1de07add7a41a73) was also verified via API: photos=3, pages=2, all 9 file URLs return 200 image/jpeg. The api.uploadPhoto web fix (real File/Blob instead of RN {uri} shim) works correctly on the web preview.

minor.issue: storage_manager.save_original (storage_manager.py:83-98) writes the SAME full-resolution bytes to originals/, thumbnails/, previews/ and print/ — no actual resizing. Thumbnails served to the upload grid are full 1200x900 files; with real phone photos (3-8MB each) the grid and preview will be very slow and storage is 4x bloated. Not part of this bug, but worth a follow-up.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated API warning in console: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions is deprecated, use ImagePicker.MediaType or an array of ImagePicker.MediaType. Reference: /app/frontend/app/create/upload.tsx:29

action_items: MINOR: Migrate ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images to the new ImagePicker.MediaType API in /app/frontend/app/create/upload.tsx:29 to silence deprecation warning (expo-image-picker).
MINOR (follow-up, not blocking): Generate real resized derivatives in storage_manager.save_original (e.g. ~300px thumbnail, ~1200px preview) instead of duplicating full-res bytes into all 4 folders.
critical_code_review_comments: api.uploadPhoto web fix is correct: uses asset.file when present, falls back to fetch(uri).blob() -> new File(...), keeps native {uri,name,type} shim for mobile only. Upload errors are now surfaced in the UI (upload.tsx err state) instead of silently swallowed.
upload.tsx deletePhoto (removePhoto) does not handle errors and does not set any loading state — a failed delete leaves stale UI until refetch. Minor.
generating.tsx silently router.back()s on autoGenerate failure with no user-facing error — user just bounces back to upload screen with no explanation. Consider surfacing the error.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: on web, expo-image-picker returns blob: URIs; React Native's FormData {uri,name,type} shim is a no-op in browsers, so the multipart body had no real file and uploads failed silently (errors were swallowed). Fix verified working: api.uploadPhoto now uses a real File/Blob on Platform.OS==='web' and surfaces upload failures via an error banner in upload.tsx. Confirmed via both direct multipart curl-style pytest (9/9) and full web-preview E2E through the actual expo-image-picker file chooser.
